playbooks.description: Explain behavior or causes from evidence without changing the product.
Compare distinct candidate approaches before committing to one.
Sequence a substantial change into verifiable units.
Build changed behavior and verify its affected consumers.
Reproduce a failure, locate its cause, repair and regression-check it.
Improve structure while proving preserved behavior.
Measure a baseline and establish a targeted performance improvement.
Identify consequential, supported findings in existing work.
Evaluate an executable result against explicit acceptance criteria.
Improve the complete user journey and verify connected behavior.
Explain a concept through the learner's project and optional practice.
Prepare reviewable evidence, decisions and remaining limitations.
Reconstruct and revalidate context before continuing work.
Propose evidence-backed improvements without silently changing doctrine.
Compare a workflow against a baseline using recorded outcomes.
